board.description: a saved filter over the tasks; membership is never stored

query.description: the filter that is the board; the empty query selects nothing

filed.description: optional portfolio filing, separate from being a task

priority.description: queue order — lower is more urgent

project.description: what it is filed under; deleting the project frees the task rather than taking it along

assignee.description: whose queue this task is filed in

domain.description: the work area this task is filed in

repository.description: the @yaks/git repository this project's work is in; its checkouts are `worktree`s of it

base_branch.description: what work branches from and lands into

gate.description: the command a change must pass before it lands

repo.description: a project's landing policy for its source: which repository it is in, what work branches from, and how a change is proven and published

phase.description: where it is: a phase, not a status, because nothing here is ever done. Suspending it is the separate `paused` component, so a phase never has to be remembered and put back

tagline.description: one line describing what it is

venture.description: a business being built: the phase it is in and its address. Who runs it is an edge, and the model an agent uses is @yaks/model's

at.description: when work on it was suspended

paused.description: work on it is suspended. A separate component, so the phase underneath is untouched and resuming means removing this one

board_check.title: Check board queries
board_check.description: Check saved board queries (filters defining which records a board displays) against the store’s vocabulary, its schema of components and fields. A board is its query, so a query naming removed components or invalid fields can leave work missing from the board; this check reports why it no longer resolves. Takes no arguments. Returns a report in content.body, with warning or failure findings when present; it does not repair the records or configuration.

project_check.title: Check project coverage
project_check.description: Report records that should belong to a project but do not. A record is checked if it has a component marked governed: true in the schema, such as task or design. It is covered if filed directly under a project or reached through containment relationships from a project or a filed record. The server chooses which relationships mean containment; the default is contains. Uncovered work can be missed by project-based reports. Takes no arguments. Returns a report in content.body, with warning or failure findings when present; it does not repair the records or configuration.
